cl:changeset.author: arcus
cl:changeset.cl:description: Create passkey table partitioned by personId for listing a person's passkeys

cl:cql.cl:update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS passkey ( personId uuid, credentialId varchar, userHandle varchar, publicKey varchar, signCount bigint, name varchar, created timestamp, lastUsed timestamp, PRIMARY KEY (personId, credentialId) )

cl:changeset.author: arcus
cl:changeset.cl:description: Create passkey_by_credential table for finding a passkey's owner during login

cl:cql.cl:update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS passkey_by_credential ( credentialId varchar, personId uuid, PRIMARY KEY (credentialId) )

cl:changeset.author: arcus
cl:changeset.cl:description: Create passkey_request table for in-progress registration and login challenges (rows are written with a TTL)

cl:cql.cl:update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS passkey_request ( requestId varchar, personId uuid, request text, PRIMARY KEY (requestId) ) WITH default_time_to_live = 3600 AND gc_grace_seconds = 3600 AND compaction = {'class': 'TimeWindowCompactionStrategy', 'compaction_window_unit': 'HOURS', 'compaction_window_size': '1'}
